samples.Test Discription: Verify top bar is visible on Manual Screening page
samples.Acceptance Criteria: Top bar is displayed at the top of the main content area and remains visible immediately on page load.
samples.Pre-condition: User is logged in and navigated to Sanction Screening > Manual Screening
samples.Expected Result: The top bar is displayed at the top of the main content area and is visible immediately on page load.

samples.Test Discription: Verify tab switching works correctly after window resize
samples.Acceptance Criteria: Tabs continue functioning correctly after browser resize with proper active state and panel visibility.
samples.Pre-condition: User is on the module page
samples.Test Steps: 1. Resize the browser window to a smaller desktop width.
samples.Expected Result: Tabs continue to switch correctly after resize, with proper active state and panel visibility.

samples.Test Discription: Verify Joint Account Holder sub-section is displayed below Basic Information
samples.Acceptance Criteria: Joint Account Holder (Optional) subsection is displayed below the Basic Information section.
samples.Pre-condition: User is on the Individual screening form
samples.Test Steps: 1. Scroll below the Basic Information section.
samples.Expected Result: The Joint Account Holder (Optional) sub-section is displayed below Basic Information.

samples.Test Discription: Verify Country of Incorporation dropdown contains the specified options
samples.Acceptance Criteria: Country of Incorporation dropdown contains all configured country options correctly.
samples.Test Steps: 1. Open the Country of Incorporation dropdown.
samples.Expected Result: The dropdown contains: Singapore, United States, United Kingdom, Cayman Islands, British Virgin Islands, Hong Kong.

samples.Test Discription: Verify each watchlist card shows title, category tag, description, and metadata pills
samples.Acceptance Criteria: Each watchlist card displays title, category tag, description, and metadata pills correctly.
samples.Pre-condition: User is on any entity form and the watchlist grid is visible
samples.Expected Result: Every card displays a bold title, a colored category tag pill, description text, and metadata pills.

samples.Test Discription: Verify button row remains stable on standard desktop layout
samples.Acceptance Criteria: Form action button row remains stable, aligned, and visually intact on desktop layout.
samples.Pre-condition: User is on any entity form in a desktop browser
samples.Test Steps: 1. Open the form at standard desktop width.
samples.Expected Result: The bottom action row stays stable, readable, and correctly aligned without layout breakage.

samples.Test Discription: Verify uploaded CSV file shows filename, size, and readiness status
samples.Acceptance Criteria: Upload zone displays CSV filename, file size in KB, and “Ready to screen” confirmation after valid upload.
samples.Pre-condition: User is on the Bulk Upload tab and a valid CSV file is available
samples.Expected Result: The zone displays the filename, file size in KB, and the message “Ready to screen”.

samples.Test Discription: Verify metadata row displays placeholder when ID Number is blank
samples.Acceptance Criteria: Metadata row displays “— (not provided)” when ID Number value is unavailable.
samples.Pre-condition: Screening Results page is available and ID Number is unavailable
samples.Expected Result: The ID Number field shows — (not provided) when the subject ID Number is blank.

samples.Test Discription: Verify summary does not incorrectly show the name-only caveat when ID is present
samples.Acceptance Criteria: AI summary does not show name-only caveat when valid ID information is available.
samples.Pre-condition: Screening Results page contains a subject record with a valid ID Number
samples.Test Steps: 1. Open a result set where the subject has a valid ID Number.
samples.Expected Result: The summary does not mention the name-only caveat when ID data is available.

samples.Test Discription: Verify All categories removes the category filter
samples.Acceptance Criteria: All rows become visible again when All categories is selected.
samples.Pre-condition: A category filter is already applied
samples.Expected Result: The category filter is cleared and all rows become visible again.
